title: neurom-program
description: Serialisable typed computation graph for one code module. Flat DAG per scope: nodes reference nodes of the same or an enclosing scope by id through `inputs` (order matters); `output` names the result node. map/fold/scan carry a `body` scope with its own params. Types come from the call site (check/compile receive the parameter types). Static typing, limits and runtime semantics are shared verbatim by frontend/ir/*.js and training/ir.py.

value.description: constant: number | boolean | string; record: ordered key list; range: length; bucket/thermometer: ascending edges; tableWindow: window length

name.description: param: parameter name; get/set: record field; tableAt/tableWindow: column

nodes.description: may be empty: the output is then a node of an enclosing scope

x-semantics.scopes: ids are unique across the whole program; a body node may reference nodes of enclosing scopes (closure), never the reverse; a `param` node resolves its name innermost-first (body params, then enclosing bodies, then program params); every scope is acyclic
x-semantics.cost: worst-case node evaluations per call: every node of a scope counts 1, a map/fold/scan adds array length x cost(body); total must be <= 2,000,000; check() reports it
x-semantics.tiers: exact rejects ln/exp; every other op is IEEE correctly rounded and bit-identical between JS and Python
x-semantics.values: number: finite double; boolean; string; vector: list of `width` finite numbers; array: list of `length` values of `of`; record: plain object with exactly the declared fields; table: { columns: {name: numbers}, lo, hi } inclusive row window, hi = lo - 1 is empty
x-semantics.arithmetic: add/sub/mul/div/mod/neg/min/max/abs/floor/ceil/round/clamp/sqrt take numbers only; a non-finite result is an error; div and mod by zero are errors; mod is JS % (fmod, sign of the dividend); round is JS Math.round (ties toward +infinity); clamp(x, lo, hi) errors when lo > hi; sqrt of a negative is an error; ln of a non-positive is an error; exp overflow is an error
x-semantics.comparison: lt/lte/gt/gte compare numbers; eq/neq compare two numbers, two booleans or two strings (IEEE / exact equality)
x-semantics.logic: and/or/not take booleans; and/or are lazy; select(condition, then, else) evaluates only the taken branch; both branches share one static type
x-semantics.vector: vector(n numbers) -> vector(n); concat(vectors | arrays of numbers | arrays of vectors) -> flattened vector; bits(n, W): W constant 1..53, n integer 0 <= n < 2^W, bit i = (n >> i) & 1 least significant first; oneHot(n, W): W constant 1..4096, n integer 0..W-1; at(vector, i) / index(vector | array, i): i integer 0..length-1 at runtime; slice(vector, S, E): constants 0 <= S < E <= width, half-open
x-semantics.record: get(record; name) reads a field; record(values; value = keys) builds a record; set(record, value; name) is a functional update keeping the field type
x-semantics.array: array(values) same type; update(array, i, value) functional replace; range(value n) = [0..n-1]; map(array; body [elem, index]) -> array of body results; fold(array, init; body [acc, elem, index]) -> final acc; scan -> array of every acc; body result type must equal init type for fold/scan
x-semantics.u32: u32(x): x safe integer -> x mod 2^32 (ToUint32); imul32/add32/sub32/xor32/and32/or32 take integers 0..2^32-1 and return the JS Math.imul / >>> 0 result; shl32/shr32(a, s): s integer 0..31, (a << s) >>> 0 and a >>> s
x-semantics.rand: rand(key, counter): both 0..2^32-1; h = key ^ imul32(counter, 0x9e3779b9); h ^= h >>> 16; h = imul32(h, 0x7feb352d); h ^= h >>> 15; h = imul32(h, 0x846ca68b); h ^= h >>> 16; result h / 2^32 in [0, 1)
x-semantics.discretise: bucket(x; edges ascending) = count(edges <= x); thermometer(x; edges) = vector with v[i] = x >= edges[i] ? 1 : 0
x-semantics.table: tableAt(table, i; name) reads column `name` at row i, lo <= i <= hi; tableWindow(table, end; name, value k) = rows end-k+1..end, all within [lo, hi]; out-of-bounds and non-finite cells are runtime errors
x-semantics.static: ids unique non-empty strings <= 64 chars; <= 4096 nodes including bodies; unknown ops, missing/extra value/name/body, wrong arity, wrong input types, unknown params/fields/columns are rejected
x-semantics.reduce: sum/minOf/maxOf/argminFirst/argmaxFirst over a vector or numeric array (statically non-empty): sum adds left to right (non-finite result is an error); argminFirst/argmaxFirst return the index of the first extreme; any/all/count over a boolean array
